reason: Spawn-worker serialization requires ConfigOptsSerializationError, introduced by oslo.config commit 4c77204 and released in 10.6.0; Resolute's bootstrap version lacks it.
Snapshot tests require FakeIdentityClient, renamed by OpenStack Client commit afc5135680323b141ef179307c01018a0fd3b671 and released in 10.1.0. Bootstrap the reverse documentation dependency instead.

Snapshot commands require openstack.block_storage.v3.message (SDK commit e997af6fd72086419ebd89b4fcd4259390fccb4f); the pinned client requires SDK >= 4.19.0. Use the candidate SDK before building the client.
Snapshot tests require SDK ensure_service_version; the pinned osc-lib requires SDK >= 4.12.0, newer than the archive bootstrap SDK.
Snapshot authentication caching requires get_unscoped_cache_id, introduced by keystoneauth commit b2a8f31 in 5.16.0; Resolute archive 5.13.1 lacks this API.

Pinned OpenStack Client requires osc-lib >=4.6.0 and calls ClientManager.is_service_available with region_name and interface. osc-lib commit 47dd091083b1c88e09dcb8c2952e8317773bab03 adds those parameters; archive 4.4.0 lacks them.
The 2026.2 Heat snapshot imports neutron_lib.api.definitions.vpn_no_sha1_3des; Resolute archive python3-neutron-lib 3.24.0 lacks that API. Build Heat against the same-run neutron-lib snapshot.
